dtz/hoeren-t1-01/1: Today the train does not leave from platform three. It leaves from platform seven. The front carriages are only for people going to Waldkirchen.
dtz/hoeren-t1-02/2: The car is ready on Friday from ten o'clock, not earlier. Only the spare part comes on Thursday, and tomorrow is not possible.
dtz/hoeren-t2-01/5: Only the concert in the evening costs five euros. Entry to the festival is free.
dtz/hoeren-t2-02/6: At the weekend, parking is free. It only costs three euros on normal days.
dtz/hoeren-t2-03/7: In the hills there are strong thunderstorms in the afternoon, so the weather is bad. It stays dry and windy only on the coast.
dtz/hoeren-t3-01/10: The pharmacist says he does not need a prescription for the drops. The prescription from the children's doctor is for the syrup.
dtz/hoeren-t3-01/11: The man can only come at half past five, so at 17:30. Tomorrow morning he has to work, and the pharmacy closes at half past six.
dtz/hoeren-t4-01/18: Sabine orders online because she has little time, but she buys fruit and vegetables herself. She does not say it is cheaper. She says it is rather more expensive.
dtz/hoeren-t4-01/19: The driver came late and the things were wrong, so Dariusz goes shopping himself again. He says it takes longer in the shop, not online.
dtz/hoeren-t4-01/20: Gerda can no longer carry crates of water and potatoes, so she orders them. She does not think the delivery fee is too expensive. She is happy to pay it.
dtz/lesen-t1-01/1: For social housing you need a housing permit (“Wohnberechtigungsschein”). You get it on the 4th floor. The housing benefit office on the 2nd floor only pays money towards the rent.
dtz/lesen-t1-02/2: Under “Mein Konto” (my account) you can turn on job alerts. Then you get a message automatically. Under “Stellenangebote” (job offers) you find the jobs, but you are not told about new ones automatically.
dtz/lesen-t2-01/6: The swimming school Delfin has courses on Saturday for children from age 5. The course at the Hallenbad Nordstadt does not fit, because it is on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
dtz/lesen-t2-01/7: The flat in Wehlheiden is furnished and free from April, but you must rent it for at least one year. There is no ad that fits three months.
dtz/lesen-t3-01/11: The technician comes to the second and third floors only on Thursday. On Tuesday he only comes to the ground floor and the first floor.
dtz/lesen-t3-01/12: You should leave the key with your neighbours or call the property management by 11 October. You only pay the 25 euros for a second appointment.
dtz/lesen-t4-01/17: Prams may stand on the ground floor under the stairs. But the way through must stay free.
dtz/lesen-t4-01/18: You make the appointment for bulky waste (“Sperrmüll”) yourself with the city cleaning service. The caretaker is only there for damage and questions.
dtz/lesen-t5-01/20: In German you cancel “zum” a date. This is a fixed phrase. “Seit” (since) does not fit, because the date is in the future.
dtz/lesen-t5-01/21: The move is the reason for the cancellation, so “deshalb” (that is why) fits. “Obwohl” (although) does not work, because then the verb would have to go at the end.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-hoeren-t1-01/1: This year the children's programme is in the tent by the lake. It is no longer on the meadow, and at the entrance there is only information.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-hoeren-t1-02/2: Miriam now wants to meet right at the park entrance. The station was the old meeting point, and the flea market is not on the market square this year.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-hoeren-t3-01/11: In the end they take one kilo of apples, because they are on offer. The cherries are too expensive, and Jonas thinks grapes in a cake are strange.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-hoeren-t3-02/12: At the end Felix suggests the tram stop, and Jana says okay. The café is too full on Saturdays, and waiting in front of the cinema is boring.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-hoeren-t3-03/13: Sabine goes by rail, so by train. The boss needs the car, and flying is too expensive.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-lesen-t2-01/6: Watches are on the ground floor, so it is not a or b. The 2nd floor only has men's clothes and shoes.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-lesen-t2-01/7: Notebooks and pens are school supplies, and those are on the 3rd floor. The ground floor has magazines, but no school things.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-lesen-t4-01/16: The course at the Volkshochschule (adult education centre) is for beginners and takes place in the evening. The cooking school Mertens is also for beginners, but only in the morning.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-lesen-t4-01/17: The holiday farm on the Baltic Sea almost fits, but animals are not allowed there. The dog hotel is not a holiday flat. There the dog stays without the family.
goethe-a2/goethe-a2-lesen-t4-01/18: The children's market sells used bikes for children up to 14 years. Radhaus Engel only has new bikes for adults.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-hoeren-t1-01/1: The technician was supposed to come on Tuesday, but he is ill. So he only comes on Thursday.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-hoeren-t1-01/2: She should leave the key with her neighbour, Frau Ludwig. The office is not possible, because it is closed on Thursdays.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-hoeren-t2-01/11: Frau Krüger says you may only take photos in the warehouse. In the production hall it is not allowed.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-hoeren-t3-01/16: Her brother wanted to help, but he cancelled because he has to work. Now only two friends are helping.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-hoeren-t3-01/17: Malte has football training in the morning. He can only come from two o'clock, so in the afternoon.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-lesen-t3-01/13: At the family centre, parents and children cook together, and her son is the right age. At the children's cooking school the parents have to stay outside.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-lesen-t3-01/14: The salsa course is in the evening, but you can only sign up as a couple. Lukas has no partner, so no ad fits.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-lesen-t3-01/15: The photo weekend is on Saturday and Sunday, and you do not need any experience. The smartphone course is on Wednesday afternoons, when Jonas is still at work.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-lesen-t5-01/27: Drinks in bottles with a lid are allowed everywhere. You may only make phone calls in the foyer and only eat in the cafeteria.
goethe-b1/goethe-b1-lesen-t5-01/28: You can use the computers for 60 minutes a day. Without an ID card you can only use the Wi-Fi. You can book at the information desk or by phone, not online.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t1-01/1: The woman needs space for a tent, so she is at the campsite. The car park is only next to the showers, and a hotel has no tents.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t1-02/2: You hear passport, luggage, flight and gate, so the man is at the airport. He only takes the train later, in Vienna.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t2-01/6: Lena says the party already starts at six o'clock. Seven o'clock was the old time.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t2-01/7: Lena says: zero seven nine, three two, five eight, nineteen. The other numbers have digits in the wrong order.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t3-01/11: Lukas now drinks tea every morning. He only drank coffee in the past.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t3-01/12: Sabine needs a big cup of coffee in the morning. Her children drink milk. She only has milk in her coffee.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-hoeren-t3-01/13: Marco usually drinks orange juice. He only drinks tea sometimes on Sunday.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-lesen-t1-01/1: The café is looking for someone for Saturday and Sunday. The supermarket is also looking for people, but only from Monday to Friday.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-lesen-t1-01/2: At Lake Constance you can rent bikes, also for a week. The workshop in Graz repairs bikes. It does not rent them out.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-lesen-t1-01/3: The bike workshop repairs bikes. The bike rental by the lake only rents out bikes.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-lesen-t2-01/6: The ad says: children's bikes are 20 percent cheaper. Cheaper (“billiger”) means they cost less.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-lesen-t2-01/7: The coffee is on Saturday, not on Sunday. On Sunday the shop is also closed.
oesd-a1/oesd-a1-lesen-t3-01/12: Paths, a meadow and dogs on a lead are in a park. Flowers and bikes are also in the text, but a shop has no meadow.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-hoeren-t1-01/1: Both radio stations say: the museums are open until one o'clock at night. They start at six o'clock in the evening.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-hoeren-t1-01/2: The buses are included in the price. With the museum ticket you travel for free.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-hoeren-t2-01/5: Miriam says you meet at the bus stop at Jakominiplatz. She mentions the main station, but you do not meet there.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-hoeren-t2-01/6: It will rain in the afternoon, so you need a rain jacket. You do not have to bring food or sun cream.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-hoeren-t3-01/10: Today Monika goes to the mountains and walks every day. She only went to the sea in the past. Now it is too hot and too crowded for her.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-hoeren-t3-01/11: Stefan goes to big cities and visits museums and churches there. He does not like staying at home on holiday at all.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-lesen-t1-01/1: The library is open again after the renovation, and it is now also open on Saturday. Heading a does not fit, because the renovation is already finished.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-lesen-t1-01/2: At the flea market you can buy old children's things cheaply. Heading e does not fit, because you do not swap anything, and it is in a school, not in a kindergarten.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-lesen-t1-01/3: The courses are for adults who cannot swim yet. Heading b does not fit, because the courses are not for children.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-lesen-t2-01/6: It annoyed her that customers simply bought new devices. The garage was only the first place for the café, not the reason.
oesd-a2/oesd-a2-lesen-t2-01/7: The text says the repair costs nothing. The café has existed for two years, but it has only been in the community hall since last autumn.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-hoeren-t1-01/1: The technician is ill on Tuesday, so the appointment is moved. He now comes on Thursday.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-hoeren-t1-01/2: She can leave the key with the caretaker on the ground floor. She should only call Herr Pichler back, not bring him the key.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-hoeren-t2-01/11: The library is closed in the morning, so the group only goes in at the very end. The eighteen francs are already included in the price of the tour, and the abbey district comes after the market square.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-hoeren-t3-01/16: Reto searched on the internet but found nothing there. A colleague got him the flat of her brother.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-hoeren-t3-01/17: Reto is still sleeping on a mattress. The bed only comes on Friday. Only the kitchen was already finished, not the whole flat.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-lesen-t1-01/1: Miriam was only supposed to work in the mornings. But at the moment she also works three afternoons, because a colleague is ill.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-lesen-t1-01/2: After training Miriam goes for a drink with the others, and that is how she met two nice people. The reason for the course was that she hardly knows anyone in Salzburg.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-lesen-t3-01/13: The course in Favoriten is in the evening and costs only 42 euros. The course in Mariahilf is also in the evening, but at 120 euros it is too expensive.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-lesen-t3-01/14: The phone photography course in Klagenfurt is only for young people aged 13 to 18. So there is no ad that fits Herbert.
oesd-b1/oesd-b1-lesen-t3-01/15: The course at the Volkshaus Linz-Urfahr is on Saturday. The Rettungsschule Donau does not fit, because its course is only on Monday and Wednesday.
start-deutsch-1/start-deutsch-1-hoeren-t: The woman says he should take the tram, and he says: „Dann mache ich das.“ (Then I'll do that.) The bus is not running today, and a taxi is too expensive.
Miriam asks Paul for a salad, and he says „Okay, gern“ (okay, happy to). Miriam already has cake, and Jana buys the drinks.
The passengers should go to gate C 7. Today the flight does not leave from gate B 12.
Mareike says: not at four, but at half past five, so at 17:30. Only the film starts at six o'clock.
On Friday the practice is already open from seven o'clock. Eight to twelve o'clock is for tomorrow, so Thursday.
start-deutsch-1/start-deutsch-1-lesen-t1: The party is in the garden of Jana's parents. It is not in Jana's flat.
Hanna should bring a salad. Jana already has enough drinks.
start-deutsch-1/start-deutsch-1-lesen-t2: The course at the VHS Kaltenbach is on Saturday from 10 to 13:00. The language school Lindner only has courses from Monday to Friday.
The course at the language school Mertens is in the evening, from 18:30 to 20:00. The course at the VHS is in the morning, when you are at work.
start-deutsch-1/start-deutsch-1-lesen-t3: Dr. Lindner is on holiday from 12 to 23 August, so the practice is closed on 20 August. On that day you have to go to Dr. Krause.
telc-a2/telc-a2-hoeren-t1-01/1: Miriam wants to meet only at half past six, so at 18:30. Four o'clock was the old plan, and only the film starts at seven.
telc-a2/telc-a2-hoeren-t1-02/2: Frau Kröger asks Herr Yilmaz to come earlier, at half past six. Eight o'clock was the old time, and the shift ends at three o'clock.
telc-a2/telc-a2-hoeren-t2-01/6: You can call from 19:30, so from half past seven. The show only starts at a quarter past eight.
telc-a2/telc-a2-hoeren-t2-02/7: In the afternoon the sun comes out everywhere. The rain in the south is only in the morning, and it only gets cooler on Sunday.
telc-a2/telc-a2-hoeren-t2-03/8: The Holstenbrücke is closed until Friday, so for a few days. The accident with the traffic jam is on the A7, and the buses are running, but on a different route.
telc-a2/telc-a2-lesen-t1-01/1: Pillows are bedding, and bedding is on the 5th floor. Household goods in the basement and children's furniture on the 3rd floor do not fit.
telc-a2/telc-a2-lesen-t2-01/6: The text says she used to be a sales assistant in a furniture store (“Möbelhaus”). A Möbelhaus is a shop for furniture.
telc-a2/telc-a2-lesen-t2-01/7: The mother only helps in the kitchen on Saturday, not every day.
telc-a2/telc-a2-lesen-t3-01/11: The family pool has a course on Saturday for children aged five to eight. The swimming school Delfin only has courses on Monday and Wednesday.
telc-a2/telc-a2-lesen-t3-01/12: The Rad-Doktor repairs bikes and makes them fit to ride again. The bike shop Speiche only sells used bikes.
telc-a2/telc-a2-lesen-t3-01/13: The English course at Lingua Plus is only in the morning. The evening course at the Volkshochschule is Spanish, not English.
telc-b1/telc-b1-hoeren-t1-01/1: Lukas does say that Sunday would be practical for him. But because of the shop assistants, he is against it.
telc-b1/telc-b1-hoeren-t1-01/2: Sabine herself would not go shopping on Sundays. But she does not mind if other people do.
telc-b1/telc-b1-hoeren-t1-01/3: Thomas says that then a lot of people come into town. He thinks that is good for shops and cafés.
telc-b1/telc-b1-hoeren-t3-01/16: The appointment on Monday is at a quarter past three, so in the afternoon. Only the appointment on Friday is in the morning.
telc-b1/telc-b1-hoeren-t3-02/17: The connecting train in Aschaffenburg does not wait. So people travelling to Miltenberg take the next train at 11:42.
telc-b1/telc-b1-lesen-t1-01/1: The news item says: people who move on the way to work are in a better mood. The text says nothing about new cycle paths in the city.
telc-b1/telc-b1-lesen-t1-01/2: The news item explains that you can still eat many foods after the date. It is about the date on the package, not about plastic in packaging.
telc-b1/telc-b1-lesen-t3-01/11: In the family course on Sunday, children from age 6 may cook with their parents. The Saturday course is only from age 16, so it is not for the daughter.
telc-b1/telc-b1-lesen-t3-01/12: The Lernstudio does offer maths for year 8. But the lessons only take place at the Lernstudio, not at home.
telc-b1/telc-b1-lesen-t4-01/21: Right after the gap comes the verb (“muss ich”). That only fits with “deshalb”. With “weil” the verb would have to go at the end, and with “denn” the subject comes first.
telc-b1/telc-b1-lesen-t4-01/22: In the relative clause, Tobias is the subject (Who works there?), so it is nominative: “der”. “Den” would be accusative and “dem” dative.
